family-care-leave-eligibility.0: If I split family care leave into shorter blocks for the same family member and the same underlying condition, does the 90-day cap reset?
family-care-leave-eligibility.1: Does the 90-day limit start over when I take family care leave in separate blocks for the same relative and the same condition?
family-care-leave-eligibility.2: If I take time off to look after my mother in a few separate stretches for the same illness, does the 90-day allowance start fresh each time?
family-care-leave-eligibility.3: I've been taking time off in chunks to look after my father through the same ongoing health problem — does the three-month allowance start again each time I go back to work in between, or does it all count together?

military-leave-service-continuity.0: After discharge from military service leave, within how many days must the employee confirm the return date with the HR desk?
military-leave-service-continuity.1: How soon after their discharge date does someone coming back from military service leave have to confirm their return to HR?
military-leave-service-continuity.2: Once my army duty ends, how quickly do I have to tell HR when I'm coming back to work?
military-leave-service-continuity.3: I'm finishing up my time in the armed forces and coming back to my job — is there a deadline for letting the people office know what day I'll be back?

policy-version-history.0: If a policy has been amended three times, does each version get its own 5-year drafts-and-proposals retention clock from its own filing date, or is there one clock for the policy?
policy-version-history.1: For a policy amended three times, does the five-year retention period run separately for each amended version from when that version was filed, or once for the whole policy?
policy-version-history.2: When a rule document has been revised several times, does each revision get its own five-year keeping period starting when it was filed, or does the whole document share a single period?
policy-version-history.3: We've changed the same internal rule three times over the years — do we have to hold on to each earlier wording for five years counted from when that wording was put in place, or can we clear out the old ones since only the latest applies?

severance-eligibility.0: If continuous service reaches 11 months and 25 days before resignation, is a prorated severance pay owed under the one-year minimum service condition?
severance-eligibility.1: Does an employee who resigns after 11 months and 25 days of continuous service receive a partial severance payment, or nothing at all?
severance-eligibility.2: If someone quits about five days short of a full year with the company, do they get a scaled-down payout or none?
severance-eligibility.3: I handed in my notice a few days before hitting twelve months at my job — am I entitled to a smaller exit payment, or does being just under wipe it out entirely?

unpaid-personal-leave-form.0: What happens if the unpaid personal leave request form is used for a leave that actually qualifies as study, military, or family care leave?
unpaid-personal-leave-form.1: If someone files this unpaid personal leave form for an absence that really belongs under study, military, or family care leave, what goes wrong?
unpaid-personal-leave-form.2: What's the consequence of submitting this general time-off request when the absence should have been logged as schooling, service, or caring for a relative?
unpaid-personal-leave-form.3: If I ask for time off using the general no-pay request and it later turns out my reason fell into one of the specific recognised types, does anything break?

vendor-performance-review.0: Does a clean performance score in a supplier review clear a sanctions or beneficial-owner match?
vendor-performance-review.1: If a vendor passes every delivery and quality check in their annual review, does that override a sanctions or beneficial-owner screening hit?
vendor-performance-review.2: Can a strong yearly assessment keep a supplier from being blocked when their name comes up on a watchlist or ownership check?
vendor-performance-review.3: We rate one of our regular contractors highly on everything we track — on-time, no defects, correct billing — but their name just came back flagged in a background check; does the good track record let us keep working with them?

wfh-recording-procedure.0: What happens if I don't submit a "Remote work" entry in the attendance system by 09:00 on the day I work from home?
wfh-recording-procedure.1: If I worked from home but never logged the remote work entry by 09:00, how does the attendance system treat that day?
wfh-recording-procedure.2: I worked a full day at home but forgot to record it anywhere before the morning deadline — what does the system show for that day and can I fix it later?
wfh-recording-procedure.3: I genuinely put in my hours from my kitchen table yesterday but never told anyone in advance or filed anything — will that day count, or am I now stuck explaining a gap?

account-holder-mismatch.0: Can a covering letter promising to fix the account name later unblock a vendor registration with an account holder mismatch?
account-holder-mismatch.1: If a vendor submits a letter undertaking to correct the mismatched bank account name afterwards, does registration still stay blocked?
account-holder-mismatch.2: Will a written promise to update the bank details later let a supplier get signed up while the account name still differs from their certificate?
account-holder-mismatch.3: My business is listed under one name but the bank account is in my wife's name from before I started trading — can I just send a note saying I'll change it soon and get approved now?

advance-authority-table.0: If a 450,000 KRW advance is authorised by a team lead but the actual spend comes in over 500,000 KRW, what has to happen before the advance can close?
advance-authority-table.1: When an advance requested at 450,000 KRW and signed off by a team lead turns out to have actually cost more than 500,000 KRW, what must be done before it can be closed out?
advance-authority-table.2: If someone gets 450,000 KRW up front with only their team lead's sign-off and then spends more than 500,000 KRW, what does the extra require before the whole thing can be settled?
advance-authority-table.3: My manager okayed 450,000 KRW for me to take on a trip, but I ended up needing over 500,000 KRW — do I need someone more senior to sign off on the difference before I can settle up?

bonus-year-end-reconciliation.0: If the annualized method under-withheld because a large bonus landed early in the year, how is the shortfall collected at the year-end settlement in February?
bonus-year-end-reconciliation.1: When too little tax was withheld on a bonus paid early in the year under the annualized method, how does the February year-end settlement recover the difference?
bonus-year-end-reconciliation.2: If not enough tax was taken off a big bonus paid near the start of the year, how do I end up paying the missing amount?
bonus-year-end-reconciliation.3: My company took too little off a large payment I got in January — when and how do I have to make up the difference?

damaged-goods-on-arrival.0: When goods arrive visibly damaged, how long should the packaging be kept before it goes to recycling?
damaged-goods-on-arrival.1: For a damaged delivery, at what point is it safe to throw out the box and pallet wrap?
damaged-goods-on-arrival.2: If something turns up broken, when can I finally get rid of the carton and padding it came in?
damaged-goods-on-arrival.3: A shipment showed up smashed — how long am I supposed to hang on to all the wrapping and cardboard before binning it?

equipment-lending-approval-role.0: If my line manager confirmed "equipment returned" by email but IT has no entry logging the return, does the deduction still go through on schedule?

equipment-lending-approval-role.2: My boss said in a chat message that I'd given the laptop back, but the tech team never recorded it — can they still take money off my last paycheque?
equipment-lending-approval-role.3: I gave my work laptop back and my supervisor wrote to say it was all sorted, but nobody in the tech department seems to have noted it down — am I still going to get charged for it when I'm paid at the end?

equity-vesting-schedule.0: If an employee leaves one week before the month-12 cliff, do they get any pro-rata credit for the eleven months served?
equity-vesting-schedule.1: Does someone who departs a week short of the one-year cliff receive a prorated portion of that 25% tranche?
equity-vesting-schedule.2: If I quit seven days before my first anniversary, do I keep any share of the 25% that would have been released at the one-year mark?
equity-vesting-schedule.3: I'm resigning a week before I hit a year — do I walk away with a fraction of the first chunk of stock for the eleven months I put in, or nothing at all?

equity-year-end-treatment.0: If I had a large vesting event mid-year, does that equity income get its own separate year-end settlement or is it reconciled in the single February run?
equity-year-end-treatment.1: When stock vests in one month and tax is withheld using the annualized method, can that one-off event be settled on its own timeline or does it wait for February with everything else?
equity-year-end-treatment.2: My shares paid out in a single month and a lot of tax was taken — do I get that sorted out separately, or does it only get fixed along with the rest of my pay in the annual reconciliation?
equity-year-end-treatment.3: I got a big one-time payout from company shares halfway through the year and too much was deducted that month; can that be straightened out on its own, or do I have to wait for the once-a-year adjustment that covers all my pay?

expense-budget-reforecast-approver.0: Which desk approves a submitted reforecast before finance applies it and it replaces the locked quarterly figure?
expense-budget-reforecast-approver.1: Who has to sign off on a reforecast after a team lead submits it, before the new number takes effect in the system?
expense-budget-reforecast-approver.2: After a manager sends in a revised budget number, who has to okay it before the system starts measuring against the new figure instead of the old one?
expense-budget-reforecast-approver.3: My team put in an updated target but we're still showing a big gap against the original — whose approval are we waiting on for the new number to actually count?

expense-ceiling-reset-deadline.0: If a December claim is filed after that month's close date, is it tested against that calendar year's ceiling or the new year's ceiling?
expense-ceiling-reset-deadline.1: What happens to December spend that misses the close date — does it still count toward last year's annual ceiling or the new one?
expense-ceiling-reset-deadline.2: If I submit an expense from December after the monthly cutoff has passed, does it count against last year's budget limit or this year's?
expense-ceiling-reset-deadline.3: I was late turning in a receipt from the end of last year — will that amount come out of the old year's allowance or eat into what I have for this year?

flexwork-system-entry.0: What happens if I log a remote day under the Leave menu instead of the Remote work menu?
flexwork-system-entry.1: If a work-from-home day gets entered in the Leave menu rather than Remote work, what goes wrong with the record?
flexwork-system-entry.2: What's the consequence of booking a home-office day as time off instead of putting it in the right place?
flexwork-system-entry.3: I marked a day I worked from my flat as a day away — will that eat into my allowance even though I actually worked?

ai-tool-data-leak-case.0: If the consumer tier of a translation tool retains input for training, what happens to the commercial terms of an unsigned contract draft pasted into it?
ai-tool-data-leak-case.1: When someone uses the free consumer tier of an approved translation tool to check a draft contract clause, why do the contract's pricing terms end up stored outside the company?
ai-tool-data-leak-case.2: If an employee runs an unsigned agreement through a free online translator to check a clause, where does that pricing information end up and why?

allowance-reimbursement-double-payment.0: If a fixed allowance has already been paid against a category, how is a reimbursement claim for the identical expense treated for tax — does it keep the nontaxable reimbursement treatment?

allowance-reimbursement-double-payment.2: If I've already received a monthly flat payment for something and then also get paid back for the actual receipt, is that second payment taxed?

allowance-reimbursement-switch-procedure.0: If a switch request from a standing monthly allowance to actual-cost reimbursement is submitted mid-month, does that cancel the current month's allowance?

allowance-reimbursement-switch-procedure.2: If I ask halfway through the month to stop getting the fixed monthly payment for car use and start claiming what I actually spend, will I still get the fixed amount for that month?

allowance-reimbursement-tax-comparison.0: If a round-sum payment is labelled "reimbursement" but submitted without receipts, what is the tax treatment?
allowance-reimbursement-tax-comparison.1: How is a reimbursement claim taxed when no receipt is attached to it?
allowance-reimbursement-tax-comparison.2: If someone asks to be paid back for a work cost but can't produce the receipt, does that money still come to them untaxed?
allowance-reimbursement-tax-comparison.3: I put in for money my company owes me for something I bought for work, but I lost the proof of purchase — will they take tax off it?

attendance-correction-request-form.0: On the attendance correction request form, what does the duplicate record option require me to enter besides which entry to keep?

attendance-dispute-escalation-procedure.1: When an employee and team lead are still arguing past the 10-day window after the month closes, is the late-correction override still required for the fix?

borrowing-original-procedure.0: If I made a photocopy of a borrowed signed original, does that close the checkout log entry?
